Woman critically ill after allegedly drinking acid from packaged water bottle

A woman in Uttar Pradesh has been hospitalized and is in critical condition after allegedly drinking acid from a packaged water bottle. She reportedly consumed the substance unknowingly. The incident raises concerns about product safety and contamination.
